goal: From the main menu, go to Open New Share, search by Member Number for the member identified by the memberId parameter, and Select their row. On the form, choose the account type whose value is the shareType parameter, enter the deposit parameter as the initial deposit, and Continue to the review screen. Verify the review screen shows the deposit you entered, then open the share. On the success screen, extract the confirmation number as confirmationNumber and the new share identifier as newShareId.
